title: Unit and associativity laws for canonical derived pullback comparisons
statement: Let the derived categories of O_X-modules of all schemes [def-pc-derived-category] be chosen. For every scheme morphism f [def-pc-scheme], choose an additive recorded tensor pullback [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction] and a left-derived counit ε_f for derivedPullback f [def-pc-derived-pullback], invertible on K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex]. Suppose c(f,g):Lg* ⋙ Lf* ≅ L(f≫g)* is a family whose hom is the canonical left-derived lift of the composite counits followed by the adjunction conjugate of pushforwardComp, using the pinned adjunctions Classical.choose of exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction. Then there are identity isomorphisms i(X):L(id_X)* ≅ id such that c(id_X,f) agrees, after id_comp transport, with whiskering i(X) followed by the right unitor, and c(f,id_Y) agrees, after comp_id transport, with whiskering i(Y) followed by the left unitor. For h:W→X, f:X→Y, g:Y→Z, whiskerRight c(f,g) Lh* followed by c(h,f≫g) equals the functor associator followed by whiskerLeft Lg* c(h,f), c(h≫f,g), and the transport along Category.assoc h f g.

proof.text: Conjugate pushforwardId under the pinned adjunction for id and the identity adjunction. This identifies tensorPullback(id) with id. Its homotopy image identifies the underived functor with Qh. Identity on the derived category is the left derived functor of Qh, by localization full faithfulness on natural transformations. Uniqueness of left derived functors gives i(X), normalized by its counit factorization.

On a K-flat P the canonical-lift factorization rewrites each unit path, after composition with the appropriate counit, to the identity tensor comparison. Adjunction mate calculus applied to pushforward_id_comp and pushforward_comp_id gives the two underived unit laws. Cancel the invertible counit on P. A K-flat resolution of any complex and naturality descend each equality, and essential surjectivity of Qh gives equality on the derived category. Equality of homs gives the stated iso unit laws.

For a triple h,f,g evaluate both paths on a K-flat P. Pullback preserves K-flatness, so the required successive counits are invertible. Repeatedly apply hc and leftDerived_fac_app; naturality moves the counits past comparisons. Both paths become the same three counits followed by the two reassociations of the underived tensor comparison. The latter are equal by adjunction mate calculus and pushforward_assoc. Cancel the final counit, descend via K-flat resolutions and Qh essential surjectivity, and use equality of homs to obtain the iso associativity law including the Category.assoc transport.

theorem derivedPullbackComposition_coherence
    [d : ∀ X : Scheme.{u₁}, HasDerivedCategory.{w₁}
      (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (a : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y), (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).Additive)
      (ε : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
        DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback f ⟶
          (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
            DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))
      (hL : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
        (derivedPullback f).IsLeftDerivedFunctor (ε f)
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
            (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hK : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
      (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ),
      CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := Y.sheaf) P →
        IsIso ((ε f).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P)))
    (c : ∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
        derivedPullback g ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅ derivedPullback (f ≫ g))
    (hc :∀ {X Y Z : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
        (c f g).hom =
          (derivedPullback (f ≫ g)).leftDerivedLift (ε (f ≫ g))
            (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso
              (SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
            (derivedPullback g ⋙ derivedPullback f)
            ((Functor.associator DerivedCategory.Qh (derivedPullback g)
                (derivedPullback f)).inv ≫
              Functor.whiskerRight (ε g) (derivedPullback f) ≫
              (Functor.associator _ DerivedCategory.Qh (derivedPullback f)).hom ≫
              Functor.whiskerLeft _ (ε f) ≫
              (Functor.associator _ _
                (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))).inv ≫
              Functor.whiskerRight
                (Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso
                  ((conjugateIsoEquiv
                    (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (f ≫ g)))
                    ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).comp
                      (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction f)))).symm
                    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp f g).symm)
                  (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).hom
                (DerivedCategory.Qh (C := SheafOfModules.{u₁} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))))
    : ∃ i : ∀ X : Scheme.{u₁}, derivedPullback (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 _,
        (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
          c (𝟙 X) f ≪≫
            eqToIso (congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y => derivedPullback k) (Category.id_comp f)) =
            Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (derivedPullback f) (i X) ≪≫
              Functor.rightUnitor (derivedPullback f)) ∧
        (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u₁}} (f : X ⟶ Y),
          c f (𝟙 Y) ≪≫
            eqToIso (congrArg (fun k : X ⟶ Y => derivedPullback k) (Category.comp_id f)) =
            Functor.isoWhiskerRight (i Y) (derivedPullback f) ≪≫
              Functor.leftUnitor (derivedPullback f)) ∧
        (∀ {W X Y Z : Scheme.{u₁}} (h : W ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z),
          Functor.isoWhiskerRight (c f g) (derivedPullback h) ≪≫ c h (f ≫ g) =
            Functor.associator (derivedPullback g) (derivedPullback f)
                (derivedPullback h) ≪≫
              Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (derivedPullback g) (c h f) ≪≫ c (h ≫ f) g ≪≫
                eqToIso (congrArg (fun k : W ⟶ Z => derivedPullback k)
                  (Category.assoc h f g)))
